stories.title: Provider Search Request/Response Schema
stories.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, radius, specialty) and outputs (provider list, scores, taxonomy metadata). Ensure compatibility with tool_router contract.

stories.title: Core Provider Search Logic (Vector + Taxonomy Fallback)
stories.description: Implement provider search orchestration using vector search via embeddings with taxonomy (NUCC) fallback when vector results are insufficient. Include specialty resolution and ranking logic.

stories.title: Location Filtering and Geo Resolution
stories.description: Implement location filtering pipeline including ZIP/FIPS-to-county mapping, state/city normalization, and distance-based filtering of providers.

stories.title: Find Care Facade Integration
stories.description: Integrate provider search service into find_care_facade to expose a unified entry point for tool_router, including error handling and response formatting for chat consumption.

stories.title: Provider Search Testing and Integration
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering vector search, taxonomy fallback, location filtering, and facade-level execution through tool_router.
